INSERT INTO representatives
                    (
                        id,
                        first_name,
                        last_name,
                        phone,
                        created_at,
                        updated_at
                    )
                VALUES
                    ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                RETURNING
                    id,
                    first_name,
                    last_name,
                    phone,
                    created_at,
                    updated_at
